newsitem.title: GERMANY: Baden-Wuertt. March CPI down 0.2, up 1.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Baden-Wuertt. March CPI down 0.2, up 1.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Consumer prices in the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg in March fell 0.2 percent month-on-month and rose 1.4 percent year-on-year, the state's statistics office said on Tuesday.
In February, the state reported a 0.4 percent rise month-on-month and a 1.7 percent rise year-on-year.
Date for four west German states are used to calculate a preliminary figure for Germany as a whole.
Excluding oil and petroleum products, the import prices index rose 0.9 percent in February from January and was up 1.4 percent from February a year ago.
The statistics office said the raw materials index rose 24 percent year-on-year in February, while finished manufacturing goods prices were up just 0.5 percent.
Export prices in February rose 0.3 percent from January and were up 0.8 percent from the same month a year earlier.
